name: Kharidian Desert (Desert Lizards)
accessNote: Desert Lizards roam the Kharidian Desert (south of the Shantay Pass and around Pollnivneach). The Desert Heat mechanic drains Hitpoints, so carry waterskins or desert-resistant gear. Each lizard must be finished with an ice cooler below 5 Hitpoints. Multi, cannon and safespot are not wiki-confirmed here, so conservative defaults are used.
